description: Zero-runtime-dependency C++20 SIMD engine for online multivariate causal discovery (Block-Schur conditional Granger, innovation precision whitening, online LiNGAM orientation), anytime-valid Ville E-process change detection, counterfactual do-interventions, and lossless-recoverable stream digests.
rules: Install with `pip install causalsieve` (zero runtime dependencies) or run the MCP server with `uvx --from causalsieve causalsieve-mcp`.
Use `CausalSieve.push_batch()` with contiguous float64 NumPy arrays or `array('d')` buffers for peak batch throughput instead of per-tick Python loops.
Use `build_digest()` and `slice://<stream_id>/<channel>/<start>..<end>` recovery handles instead of passing raw telemetry CSV or JSON rows into LLM context.
Use `analyze_dataframe()`, `analyze_prometheus()`, `analyze_otlp_metrics()`, `analyze_jsonl()`, or `rcaeval_rca()` for zero-dependency ingestion with strict causal forward-fill.
Keep `normalize_scale=True` (default) for telemetry with large DC offsets or flat channels, and enable `nonlinear_hinge=True` only when modeling asymmetric threshold saturation cascades.
Use `causalsieve watch` to stream CSV or JSONL telemetry incrementally from stdin or files with real-time Ville E-process alerts.
